title: ToolCall
description: tool_call: run a tool of the node. The node checks the arguments and its harness again, and answers with tool_result.

callId.description: The id of the call; the answers refer to it.

tool.description: The name in the manifest, without the node's name.

turn.description: The id of the say whose turn called it, null when the turn did not come from this node.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long the server waits for the result after the last frame about the call (an approval that is asked waits for the user).
